title: fix: update Enter community links
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Refreshes the Enter drawer counts to 5k GitHub stars and 19k Discord members.
- Replaces the Pollen Beta shortcut with “Get Help” linking to the community chat.
- Renames “Report an issue” to “Report a Bug” and adds a shared UI bug icon.
- Verified with Biome, UI and Enter typechecks, and a local browser check including GitHub sign-in.

gist.headline: The help drawer grew up
gist.blurb: Enter’s community drawer got its numbers refreshed and its shortcuts put to better use. Polli replaced the old Beta path with a proper door to the people who can help.
gist.summary: Updated the Enter dashboard drawer with 5k GitHub stars and 19k Discord members, replaced the Pollen Beta shortcut with a Get Help link to community chat, and renamed Report an issue to Report a Bug with a shared bug icon.
gist.impact: Enter users now see current community counts and have clearer, direct routes to community help and bug reporting from the dashboard.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy Enter dashboard help drawer becomes a little community garden noticeboard: Polli updates a star counter and hangs two clear signposts, one for Get Help leading to a friendly chat room and one with a tiny bug icon for reporting bugs. Include glowing retro terminal elements, flowers, and code-vines to make navigation feel like a welcoming shared space.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny librarian scarf, pinning a lime green (#ecf874) community noticeboard beside a retro CRT terminal; the board shows chunky pixel signs reading “GET HELP,” “5K STARS,” and “19K FRIENDS,” with a tiny friendly bug icon, flowers, and code-plants growing around it. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley, dark purple (#110518) outlines, nostalgic and emotionally warm.
